Quick update from Platform:
- Observed spike is concentrated on gpu-pool-west-2 (nodes n-ww-1..n-ww-6) — queue depth increased 7x; p95/p99 CPU and GPU wait time up.
- Autoscaler showed multiple failed allocation attempts between 06:20 and 06:55 UTC due to ephemeral host capacity; underlying cloud AZ reported transient API throttling.
- Immediate mitigation: starting a controlled drain of gpu-pool-west-2 and shifting ~60% of traffic for Stellar to us-west-1 (graceful connection migration).
- ETA for initial traffic shift: ~12 minutes. We'll enable temporary 75% QPS cap + token batching adjustments to limit cost.

I'll post the PD incident and the live console link shortly.

Hannah
